The Defence Minister today launched Fleet Support Ship 1, laid the
keel for Fleet Support Ship 5, and inaugurated the upgraded slipway for

Addressing the gathering, Mr Singh said the launch of Fleet Support Ship 1,
Key laying of Fleet Support Ship 5 and inauguration of upgraded infrastructure at HSL mark important steps in strengthening India's maritime capabilities.
He said Fleet Support Ship 1 named Surya will strengthen the Indian Navy's reach, endurance and operational effectiveness.

Digital telemedicine service East Anjivani has crossed 50 crore teleconsultations, marking
a significant milestone in the government's efforts to leverage digital technology to make
quality healthcare more accessible, affordable, and equitable for citizens across the country.
The platform has evolved with the integration of an artificial intelligence-powered clinical
decision support system which supports healthcare providers during consultations
and assists in strengthening the quality, consistency and efficiency of clinical decision-making.
The innovation has received national recognition with the Gold Award under the National Award
for E-Governance 2026.
E-Sanjivni has also been integrated with the Emergency Response Support System 112, enabling
stronger linkages between emergency response services and remote medical expertise.
The integration is aimed at facilitating more coordinated access to medical support
and further strengthening the use of digital technology in emergency health care.
With Rishu Jaiswal, Akshit Vadyan, Akashwani News, Delhi.
The BJP today hit out a Congress leader, Rahul Gandhi, over his protest against SIR
and intruding into Akashwani Bhavan.

For several weeks now, election commission has been attacked.

Prime Minister Narendra Modi is completing 25 years in public service, a journey defined

Guided by this vision for SEVA and Sushasan, the government has been ceaselessly working
towards achieving the goal of a Vekasit Bharat by 2047.
Through inclusive development and social empowerment, this dedication is transforming lives.
Today in our special series, we bring you a report from our Gujarat correspondent on
the visionary project, the Statue of Unity.
Standing at a majestic height of 182 meters on Sadhubeet in Narmada river, the Statue
of unity is the tallest statue on the earth.
Dedicated to the Iron Man of India, Sardar Vallapai Patel, this statue was inaugurated
on October 31, 2018.
Designed to eco-gutrats 182 assembly constituencies, the figure stands nearly twice as tall as
the Statue of Liberty.
Built through widespread Jan Bhagidari, millions of farmers across the country donated iron

The World Bank has raised its forecast for India's GDP growth in the current financial
year to 7.1%, up from 6.6% projected in April.
The revision follows stronger than expected growth, with the economy expanding 7.8 percent
in the first quarter of FY 27, supported by robust private consumption and investment.
The World Bank said private consumption is likely to remain the main growth driver,
while stronger public investment and supportive financial and policy conditions will provide
further support.
India has reiterated its call for reform of international financial institutions to
ensure a greater representation for the global south and provide developing countries with
affordable and predictable financing.
Speaking of the UN General Assembly's second committee, Member of Parliament CP Joshi
said, global financial institutions must be restructured to meet the needs of the 21st
century.
Mr Joshi highlighted India's support for development in the global south through the India-U.N.
Development Partnership Fund, the APSA Fund, the International Solar Alliance and
and the Coalition for Disaster Resilient Infrastructure.
Union Civil Aviation Minister Ram Mohan Naidoo today said the West Asia crisis is one of
the major concerns as it has put a significant burden leading to rise in aviation turbine
fuel ATF prices.
Talking to media in New Delhi, Mr Naidoo said the Government is in discussions with
airlines and oil marketing companies regarding ATF prices to assess the situation.
One of the most important things is the West Asia crisis and how it is putting a big burden
on the ATF crisis, but we are still in discussion both with the airlines and also the OMCs.
Let us see how the discussion is.
Fighting intensified in Yemen today as the Saudi-led coalition carried out new operations
against Houthi targets.
The Saudi coalition said its naval forces conducted an operation in Hodeidah, destroying
weapon depots, facilities storing explosive laden boats and naval mines, and thwarting
planned attacks on southern Red Sea waterways.
More from our correspondent.
Yemen Government forces launched a major offensive against the Houthis on Monday called Operation
Dawn of Yemen backed by Saudi air power.
They claimed gains around the strategic Babel-Mandab Strait and along the Red Sea coast.
The government said the operation aims to retake Houthi-held territory and eventually
regain control of Sanaa.
Today, the Saudi-led coalition said its naval forces carried out an operation in Hodeidah,
destroying Houthi weapons depots, facilities for explosive laden boats and naval mines
and thwarting planned attacks on southern Red Sea waterways.
The coalition also claimed to have destroyed a ballistic missile launch platform in Sanaa.
Manish Siba, Akashwani News, Dover.
In men's cricket, the first T20 International of the Five Mat series between India and
West Indies will be held in Lucknow today. After winning gold at the 2026 Asian Games
and a convincing 2-1 victory in the ODI series, the hosts will aim to continue their winning
run against the visitors.
Indian women's cricket captain Harmanpreet Kaur has stepped down as captain across all three
formats. The 37-year-old announced her decision after a BCCI review meeting in Guwahati.
Harmanpreet led India to its maiden ODI World Cup title last year, and also guided the team
to gold at the Asian Games.
